Enjoy Better Marketing Returns with Folded Postcards


Folded postcards give you twice the space of a standard postcard, allowing more room for visuals, offers, and essential details. They fold like a brochure, making them ideal for announcements, menus, invitations, or multi-section promotions. Compact when folded yet spacious when opened, they let you share your story while keeping the format easy to distribute and mail.

Folded Postcard FAQs

Q: Can I review the folded postcard before it's printed?

Yes, you can request to view and approve the folded postcard design before it proceeds to production. After selecting “Upload Your File & Order Now” on the online calculator, choose “Wait - I want to receive and approve a free PDF proof” under the “Proofing Option” section. You'll be emailed a link to your PDF proof. We will only send the file to production once we have received your online approval.

Q: How do I ensure an uploaded file is print-ready?

We accept file submissions in the following formats: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIF, TIFF, EPS, AI, and PUB. Other important file specifications to review before sending are:

  1. Set the file's color mode to CMYK.
  2. Make sure the design is applied according to the following print guidelines:
    • Safe zone - Do not place important text or images beyond this dotted area.
    • Trim line - Indicates where we will cut to achieve the indicated size. Make sure to apply the background color or image up to this point.
    • Bleed - Extend your artwork to the edge of this line. It is measured at 1/8”.
  3. All images and text should have a 300 dpi resolution.

 

Q: Can I save more with bulk printing?

Yes, the larger your order quantity, the lower you spend per postcard. The online calculator will show the total price and how much you'll spend for each after inputting the specifications.
